_comment: Last committed evaluation summary, surfaced live by GET /snapshot for downstream consumers (e.g. the AI Product & Leadership Studio). Operational metrics (latency, grounded rate, cost) come live from /stats; these judged metrics come from the eval harness (npm run eval:judge / npm run eval) and are refreshed when that runs. Keep numbers in sync with the README Phase 4 table.
_syncGapNote: 2026-08-15: npm run eval:judge completed a full cycle (first since the checkpoint/resume wiring landed, commits e37be8c/d19e857) and its numbers were written into README.md's Phase 4 table by commit 7e0cf1a — but that commit forgot to also update THIS file, so GET /snapshot kept serving the stale 2026-07-17 numbers (Faithfulness 67, OOS-Refusal 80) to downstream consumers even though the run had succeeded. Fixed here to match README/eval/judge-results.json. Lesson for any agent editing the README Phase 4 table: this file is hand-maintained and does NOT auto-update from npm run eval:judge (that script only writes eval/judge-results.json, which is gitignored) — always update this file in the same commit as the README Phase 4 table.
